params.target_cols: List of y labels to evaluate
params.approved_col: Approval flag field; when empty, n_approved_observed is not computed

params.write_excel: Whether to output the Excel report with ExcelMaster
params.dry_run: Whether to only estimate the number of split candidates without actually running

level2.name: Time and Population Dimensions

params.time_dims: List of time dimensions, default apply_week/apply_month/apply_quarter
params.population_dims: List of population dimensions, default channel/strategy_version

rules: segment_bad_rate_summary outputs global, time, population, and time x population
profile_summary uses the same set of grouping dimensions

params.profile_cols: List of profile fields, default age/income/education/credit_limit

level2.name: OOT Windows

params.oot_time_dim: Time dimension used to split off the OOT, default apply_month
params.oot_windows: List of candidate OOT tail-window lengths, default [1,2,3,6]

rules: Each target_col uses only the mature samples with a non-null value for that target
OOT takes the last N periods after sorting by oot_time_dim

level2.name: INS/OOS and Random Seeds

params.random_seeds: List of random seeds, default range(3000,3020)
params.min_sample_size: Sample-size filtering threshold for the recommended scheme

rules: When stratification fails, it automatically falls back to stratify=false
The recommendation ranking prefers a smaller max_abs_bad_rate_gap, then looks at the OOT sample size and closeness to 75/25

params.materialize_split: When True, replays the recommended (window, ratio, seed) into a row-level INS/OOS/OOT assignment long table (default False)
params.id_col: Row-level primary key; required for materialization, and must be unique among matured rows (duplicates raise an error with counts)
params.oot_cutoff: When set, OOT=oot_time_dim>=cutoff overrides the recommended window; the artifact records oot_basis=cutoff|window
params.split_col_name: Output split column name, default sample_split, which can be fed straight back into the CMP/FVP split_col
params.persist_split_map: When True, writes row_level_split.csv + split_artifact.json (including sha256 ID hashes of the four segments ins/oos/oot/full) to disk

requirement_note: The required category contains the data-field entry points that sample analysis must confirm; the target label, time field, and approval field basis need to be confirmed.

stratify.meaning: Whether to sample stratified by target

exclude_cols.meaning: Columns that take no part in the split strategy; they are not removed from the output DataFrame

accepted_params.oot_time_dim: Takes the tail oot_windows periods after sorting by this field as the OOT
accepted_params.random_seeds: List of random seeds for repeated splitting at each candidate ratio
